title: Bronze age treasure stolen in four-minute Spanish museum heist
summary_full: Gold collection known as Treasure of Villena, worth at least €1.7m, is target of ‘very well planned’ raidThieves in Spain have raided the Treasure of Villena – a stunning collection of bronze age gold artefacts that has been described as the most important prehistoric trove in Europe – in the latest high-profile smash-and-grab heist on the continent.The raid on Thursday morning of the 66 mostly gold objects in the Spanish town of Villena lasted just minutes, officials said.
